question: Coulomb’s law gives an exact inverse-square force only under which condition?

options.A: For two point charges at rest in a uniform medium; for finite bodies it may be used via point-charge elements.
options.B: For charges moving with any speed, since motion does not affect electrostatic force.
options.C: For extended charged bodies at any separation without resolving them into elements.
options.D: For non-electrostatic cases with time-varying charges and fields.
